issues.desc: background.md and index.json never introduce or number the W1/W2/W3/S1/S2 workstream program codes; they only appear in .lattice/story/actives/B-956f/scope-boundary.json (excluded list + confirmationNote: W1=this story, W2=RED evidence subsystem, W3=enforce flip, S1=orchestrator routing, S2=lock/digest portability). A fresh reader relying only on background.md/index.json/checklist.json has no map of the larger initiative this story is one slice of. Collision risk remains: CLAUDE.md line ~35 already uses S1 for an unrelated meaning (lattice-review-channel retirement).
